patch_description: This replaces route-by-route two-hop rewards with a static soft-routing load estimate. Demand is softly assigned across possible intermediate nodes to estimate which links may become heavily loaded; linear costs and sparse pairwise penalties then discourage selecting multiple high-load links with the same source or destination. The resulting couplings are compact and organized around node-local link groups, aiming to give the sampler and post-processor a more useful load-balancing signal without flooding the QUBO with path terms.
